overview: 求均质曲杆的重心坐标
content: 均质曲杆尺寸如图所示，求此曲杆重心坐标。
explanation:
将均质曲杆分成 5 段，各段长度分别为 $200$、$100$、$100$、$200$、$100\ \mathrm{mm}$，总长 $\sum l = 700\ \mathrm{mm}$。取各段中点为该段重心，按重心坐标公式计算：

$$x_C = \frac{\sum l_i x_i}{\sum l_i} = \frac{200\times(-100) + 100\times(-50) + 100\times0 + 200\times100 + 100\times200}{700} = \frac{15000}{700} = 21.43\ \mathrm{mm}$$

$$y_C = \frac{\sum l_i y_i}{\sum l_i} = \frac{200\times(-100) + 100\times0 + 100\times50 + 200\times100 + 100\times100}{700} = \frac{15000}{700} = 21.43\ \mathrm{mm}$$

$$z_C = \frac{\sum l_i z_i}{\sum l_i} = \frac{200\times0 + 100\times0 + 100\times0 + 200\times0 + 100\times(-50)}{700} = \frac{-5000}{700} = -7.14\ \mathrm{mm}$$
